newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MRCB, NST, TV3 shares suspended.
newsitem.headline: MRCB, NST, TV3 shares suspended.

text.p: Shares of Malaysian Resources Corp Bhd (MRCB), New Straits Times Press (M) Bhd (NST) and Sistem Televisyen Malaysia Bhd (TV3) were suspended on Friday pending announcement, an official at the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange said.
MRCB owns a 48.0 percent stake in publishing group NST and 43.2 percent interest in TV3, which operates a private television station.
Company officials could not be immediately reached for comment.

Shares of MRCB, a diversified group with interests in power generation, media, property development and financial services, closed on Thursday at 9.80 ringgit. NST stock was last traded at 15.20 ringgit and TV3 at 5.80 ringgit.
